content.text:
Setting policy "xplanbox-delivery-limit" for pattern ".*" to "{"delivery-limit":1}" with priority "0" for vhost "/" ...
=== policies ===
Listing policies for vhost "/" ...
vhost	name	pattern	apply-to	definition	priority
/	xplanbox-delivery-limit	.*	queues	{"delivery-limit":1}	0

observation.command:
export RABBITMQ_NODENAME=rabbit@localhost RABBITMQ_NODE_IP_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1
rabbitmqctl set_policy xplanbox-delivery-limit --apply-to queues ".*" '{"delivery-limit":1}' 2>&1
echo "=== policies ==="
rabbitmqctl list_policies 2>&1
